Test: Follow one service question from entry page to next action
Expected behavior: The intended visitor can identify fit and reach a clear next step
Needs access status: Public page; record device and task

Test: Compare package/service boundary with contact entry
Expected behavior: Chosen service and key scope remain clear through the next step

Test: Read the headline and main service explanation together
Expected behavior: They answer one identifiable customer question without contradictory scope

Test: Check proof; location claims; prices and exclusions
Expected behavior: Claims have evidence; actual delivery/location is clear; prices and exclusions match the accepted offer
Needs access status: Approved facts and offer authority needed

Test: Open important internal links and expected final URLs
Expected behavior: Each link reaches the intended useful destination without a broken or misleading route
Needs access status: Public pages; server access may be needed for diagnosis

Test: Compare canonical; robots meta/header and indexing policy
Expected behavior: Controls agree with the intended publication policy; deliberate noindex is recorded rather than silently removed
Needs access status: Owner indexing decision required; Search Console needs authorized access

Test: Repeat the main task at narrow phone width and enlarged text
Expected behavior: Important content and controls remain readable and usable without lost information

Test: Observe cold loading and content movement
Expected behavior: Primary content arrives in a useful order; layout changes do not disrupt the task
Needs access status: Record date; connection; device; lab versus field method

Test: Use the main path with keyboard only
Expected behavior: Relevant controls can be reached and operated; focus stays visible and follows a useful order
Needs access status: Public page; does not constitute full accessibility testing

Test: Inspect labels; image alternatives; enlarged text and reduced-motion behavior
Expected behavior: Controls have understandable labels; meaningful images have useful alternatives; motion and text settings preserve the task
Needs access status: Assistive-technology and human checks may be needed

Test: Try an agreed invalid example and inspect recovery
Expected behavior: Useful field errors explain the problem; chosen service and safe entered values survive retry
Needs access status: Agree synthetic data and test scope; do not include private information

Test: Verify browser confirmation; stored record and notification separately
Expected behavior: An authorized synthetic test establishes each claimed stage with a dated reference
Needs access status: Needs explicit test authorization and appropriate storage/inbox access; invalid response is not a saved inquiry

Test: Identify domain; hosting; CMS and workflow account owners
Expected behavior: The actual owners and delegated permissions are documented without sharing credentials

Test: Inspect a recoverable version; export and restore procedure
Expected behavior: A safe authorized recovery exercise establishes the claimed recovery step and its limits
Needs access status: Needs safe environment; backup; permission; agreed rollback

Test: Define the decision and inspect relevant page/query or inquiry evidence
Expected behavior: Source; dates; sample and access limits are recorded; unavailable data is not treated as zero
Needs access status: Needs authorized analytics/Search Console/inquiry evidence where applicable

Test: Compare the changed task with its original evidence
Expected behavior: Retest verifies the correction; business/search effects are labeled as observations with limits
Needs access status: Use private records safely; public receipts omit personal data
